title: Camps with walls
changes: Each clan now builds its camp its own way: Wardens a big palisade fort with a watchtower, Redfang a loose ring of tents and stakes, the Ossuary Host a stone keep with corner towers, the Hide-Kin an earth bank round a burrow, the Veiled a sandstone shrine with pylons.
Camp walls, towers, tents and fences are solid now: you can no longer walk through them. Enter through the gates and gaps.
When a land changes hands, its camp is rebuilt in the new holder's style.
